描述_ZN: The Wuyi Landing scroll, Yuan, by Fang Congyi, ink and wash on paper, 74.4 cm in length and 27.8 cm in width.　　This painting depicts a view of the Wuyi Mountains. Wuyi Mountain is located in the southwest of Chong'an County, Fujian Province, and stretches for more than a hundred miles, with 36 peaks and 37 rocks, between which water flows in nine curves. In ancient times, Taoists called it the 16th Cave of Heaven, and it was a more concentrated area for Taoist activities. This picture was made by Fang Congyi for his fellow Taoist Zhou Jingxin. On the right side of the picture, a peak towers above the water, and a small boat paddles slowly in the water below the peak, while strange rocks and trees grow on the shore. The brushwork and ink are rich and fluid, and the mountain is chalked with long vertical lines to enhance its sense of craggy height. The layout is peculiar and the brushwork is varied, blending ancient methods into its own use and showing a unique artistic style.　　The upper right side of this painting is titled in official script: "Wuyi Shuo". On the left side of the painting, it reads: "I am very happy to see you, Mr. Zhou, who has been visiting Wuyi for a year. Because of the imitation of Ju Ran pen intention here, send Zhong announced, fortunate to reach the. In the winter of Jizheng Jihai, Fang Hu was acquainted with Wushi Mountain. Inscription: "Fang Hu Qing Yin" seal. The year "Zhizheng Jihai" is the nineteenth year of Yuan Zhizheng (1359), so this picture should be Fang's work in his later years. "Wushi Mountain" refers to Min Mountain, which is located in Minhou County, Fujian Province.　　This painting is inscribed with "Bian Lingzhi's Authentication", "Shiqu Baoji", "Chen Rentao", "Qianlong Imperial Treasures", and "Sanxitang Jingjian Seal", "Sanxitang Jingjian Seal", "Yizi Sun", "Xinxuan", "Jinji Baozang Chen's Rentao", and "Qianlong Appreciation", "Tan" "Jing" (Fang Lianzhu), "Xu'an", "Xu'an "Guqian Chen Shaoshi Kaozang famous works", "An's Yi Zhou chapter of calligraphy and painting", "style Gu Tang calligraphy and painting" and other appreciation seal 15.　　Recorded in "Da Guan Lu" volume 19, "Style Gu Tang calligraphy and painting repertory examination" volume 23, "Bao迂阁 calligraphy and painting record" volume 1.
